title: paracraft operation declaration record
description: the typed record a studio parameter state carries for a single declared operation. this is the studio-to-paracraft handshake: the studio tells paracraft what it is doing and the relevant dimensions; paracraft evaluates the op's constraints against those declared values. the harness does not infer operations from mesh geometry. one declaration per operation per surface. this file is a contract sketch, not engine code; no compiler changes in this batch.

op.description: the op_id of the declared operation. must match a record in research/operations/operations.jsonl.

surface.description: a stable identifier for the surface or body this operation is applied to. used in verdict output to locate the failing operation. examples: 'ring-shank-exterior', 'pendant-face-front', 'band-inner'. arbitrary string; paracraft does not validate it against a registry in this batch.

method.description: optional method qualifier for operations that have sub-types. text: the operation was applied as typography (letter forms). pattern: the operation was applied as a repeating geometric pattern. freehand: the operation was applied as an arbitrary drawn form. not all ops use method. engrave and emboss use it; wire, stub, and through_hole do not.

depth_mm.description: for op-engrave: the depth of the recess below the parent surface, in mm. the remaining wall after the cut is inferred as base_wall_mm - depth_mm when base_wall_mm is provided, or must be supplied as remaining_wall_mm.

height_mm.description: for op-emboss: the height of the raised relief above the parent surface, in mm. for op-wire and op-stub: the total height of the element above its base attachment point, in mm.

width_mm.description: for op-engrave: the width of the recess at its opening, in mm. for op-emboss: the width of the relief feature at its neck (narrowest point), in mm. governs depth-to-width ratio checks.

diameter_mm.description: for op-wire, op-stub: the diameter of the element at its tip (narrowest point), in mm. for op-through_hole: the diameter of the hole at its opening, in mm.

remaining_wall_mm.description: for op-engrave: the wall thickness remaining below the bottom of the recess, in mm. if not supplied, the harness infers it from base_wall_mm - depth_mm. this is the value checked against ctr-wall-001 and ctr-engrave-002.

base_wall_mm.description: the wall thickness of the parent body at the point of operation, before the operation is applied. used to infer remaining_wall_mm for op-engrave when remaining_wall_mm is not supplied directly.

spacing_mm.description: for op-engrave and op-emboss: the minimum spacing between adjacent features of the same operation on the same surface, in mm. checked against min_spacing in ctr-engrave-001 and ctr-engrave-002.

draft_angle_deg.description: for op-engrave: the taper angle on the walls of the recess, in degrees. 0 is vertical walls; positive values mean the opening is wider than the bottom. hoover & strong (src-0007) recommend 7 degrees; morris and watson (src-0022) recommend 5-10 degrees.

depth_to_width_ratio.description: for op-engrave: ratio of depth_mm to width_mm. if not supplied, the harness computes it from depth_mm / width_mm when both are present. cooksongold / stuller consensus: max 2.0. materialise: max 1.0. conflict unresolved.
